Task 2: Perform statistical analysis
```{r}
# Calculate mean
mean(iris$Sepal.Length)

# Calculate median

# Calculate standard deviation
sd(iris$Sepal.Length)

# Find minimum and maximum

max(iris$Sepal.Length)

# Count observations

# Count flowers by species
table(iris$Species)
```

Task 5:Importing data using APIs
```{r}
install.packages("httr2", repos = "https://cloud.r-project.org")
install.packages("jsonlite", repos = "https://cloud.r-project.org")
```

```{r api-import}

# Load packages
library(httr2)
library(jsonlite)

# API URL
url <- "https://jsonplaceholder.typicode.com/users"

# Send API request
response <- httr2::request(url) |>
  httr2::req_perform()

# Convert JSON response into a data frame
data_api <- jsonlite::fromJSON(
  httr2::resp_body_string(response)
)

# Display first six records
head(data_api)

# Check dataset structure
str(data_api)

# Display column names
names(data_api)

# Check dimensions
dim(data_api)
```
Task 6:Connect RStudio to MySQL
```{r}
install.packages("DBI", repos = "https://cloud.r-project.org")

install.packages("RMySQL", repos = "https://cloud.r-project.org")

```
```{r mysql-connection }

# Load required packages
library(DBI)
library(RMySQL)

# Connect to MySQL database
con <- dbConnect(
  RMySQL::MySQL(),
  host = "127.0.0.1",
  port = 3306,
  dbname = "student_db",
  user = "root",
  password = ""
)

# Test the connection
dbGetQuery(con, "SELECT 1 AS test")

# Display database tables
dbListTables(con)

# Import students table
students <- dbReadTable(con, "students")

# Display the data
head(students)

# Check structure
str(students)

# Display column names
names(students)

# Close the connection
dbDisconnect(con)

```
